newsitem.title: JAPAN: Arjuna LPG discount for 1997 narrows--traders.
newsitem.headline: Arjuna LPG discount for 1997 narrows--traders.

text.p: The discount of Arjuna liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to the Saudi benchmark contract has narrowed to single digits for 1997 from a double-digit discount in 1996, Japanese traders said on Tuesday.
The discount was set in a deal by Itochu Corp with Indonesia to buy about 300,000 tonnes of LPG for 1997 from the Arjuna oil field off Java, they said.
The volume was virtually unchanged from Itochu's term cargoes lifted in 1996, they added. Itochu is the leading buyer of Arjuna LPG.
The traders did not reveal the exact level of the discount to Saudi Arabian contract prices, which are the industry benchmark formula issued by state-owned oil firm Saudi Aramco.
